text: Abigail gripped the handrail of the *Starlight*, a sleek, electric-powered vessel that hummed softly as it glided through the smog-choked waters of the Thames. It was 2084, and she was leaving behind the suffocating surveillance state of her home sector in Neo-London for the promise of anonymity and freedom in the Off-Grid Colonies of Mars. She clutched her small, battered data-slate that contained all her encrypted memories and identity codes, her heart racing with both fear and excitement. Tell me what a book is primarily made of.
